# BiggerPockets

> > BiggerPockets is the premier real estate investing education platform offering books, training resources, and community tools for rental property investors, fix-and-flip investors, and real estate agents.

BiggerPockets provides comprehensive real estate investing education through books authored by industry experts like Brandon Turner, David Greene, J Scott, and Scott Trench. The platform supports investors at all levels with resources covering BRRRR strategy, creative financing, property management, and agent training, alongside community features and BiggerPockets Pro membership.

## Key Topics

- Real Estate Investing
- Rental Properties
- BRRRR Strategy
- Fix and Flip
- Financial Freedom
- Creative Finance
- Property Management
- BiggerPockets Pro
- BPCON
- Brandon Turner
- David Greene
- J Scott
- Scott Trench
- Real Estate Agents
- Agent Training
